title: ZDD repo config (zdd/config.json)
description: Per-repo ZDD configuration: which extractors to run, where the artifacts live, and per-extractor source paths. Artifact CONTENTS never live here — this is the small, portable config tier only.

extractors.description: Extractors to run, composed: one per convention in the stack (built-in: supabase, nextjs, fastapi, generic). Selected by NAME from the engine's registry or from localExtractorDir — never by path. Records from every extractor are merged and cross-extractor refs resolved after the merge.

extractorOptions.description: Per-extractor source configuration, keyed by extractor name. Built-ins are described below; a local extractor's options are whatever its module documents. Every path is repo-relative POSIX — absolute paths and '..' are refused at runtime.

migrationNamespaces.description: One entry per database: SQL migrations under `dir` (non-recursive) replay into namespace `name`.

externalBuckets.description: Storage buckets that exist but were never created by a migration here.

middlewarePath.description: middleware.ts whose config.matcher decides session auth.

srcAliasRoot.description: Where the tsconfig @/ alias points; default appDir's parent.

refs.description: Source files scanned for outbound references. Any omitted field takes its default.

roots.description: Files or directories scanned for .py handlers.

localExtractorDir.description: Repo-relative directory holding repo-local extractors (<name>.mjs or <name>/index.mjs), each selectable by name in `extractors`. The one place config may point at code; a one-off convention lives here instead of in a fork. Local names may not shadow built-ins.

adapter.description: DEPRECATED (pre-1.0): the single monolithic adapter. Still honoured — `nextjs-supabase` expands to extractors [supabase, nextjs] with adapterOptions split by key — but prints a deprecation note on every derive telling you how to migrate (a future `bootstrap --upgrade` will do it for you).

adapterOptions.description: DEPRECATED (pre-1.0): options for the single `adapter`. Use extractorOptions.

name.description: Display name for the indexes (agent-index heading, human-index title).

repoBase.description: GitHub tree URL prefix for source links in the human index, e.g. https://github.com/org/repo/tree/main/. Empty = relative links. Must be http(s) — the renderer refuses anything else, since it becomes every source link's scheme.

nonAreaTags.description: Tags that are properties rather than product areas (tech tags like react-flow, rls-disabled). A metadata record inherits its area from the first tag of its claiming feature that is NOT listed here — this shapes graph.json, which is why it is top-level and not a viewer option. The pre-0.4 home, viewer.nonAreaTags, is still read with a deprecation note.

baseBranch.description: The branch PRs merge into. Freshness diffs and the renderer's changed-set highlight key on origin/<baseBranch>.

paths.description: Where each artifact lives. Defaults are the self-contained zdd/* layout; point elsewhere only if adopting an existing glossary/ADR directory.

graph.description: The graph artifact (schema zdd-graph/1) the human index is rendered from — generated, checked by render --check.

bundleDir.description: The folder graph node ids are relative to — the zdd/ folder itself.

storeChanges.description: Set false to render with no git dependency — drops the 'what just changed' highlight from the human index.

agentIndex.description: Renderer options for the agent index (e.g. the blockquote summary line).

viewer.description: Which viewer renders the human index from the graph artifact, and its options. A name (built-in: cytoscape, minimal) or an object whose `name` selects the viewer and whose other keys are its options — for cytoscape: defaultFocus, authHubs, nonAreaTags. An object without `name` (the pre-registry shape) means cytoscape.

defaultFocus.description: cytoscape: node id the explorer view opens on.

authHubs.description: cytoscape: node ids whose edges to ordinary session-auth endpoints are stated, not drawn.

nonAreaTags.description: DEPRECATED (pre-0.4 home): move to the top-level nonAreaTags key — it shapes graph.json, not just this viewer. Still honoured with a note.
